a35d9c7644: Melody checklist: range within the lead singer's usable range, no tone clashes, room to breathe, a chorus hook people can hum after one listen, contrast between verse and chorus, and an ending that returns to the tonic.

36e57dc83b: A good vocal decides eighty per cent of how much a song matters.
7e5183b1f6: Choosing your own key: half steps to transpose = highest usable note − song's highest note. Make them the same, or take the song down another one or two half steps to leave some headroom.
